title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. translated_title: 当视频验证器得分产生误导时：能力评估与验证器选择
translated_abstract: 视频验证器用于判断候选答案或轨迹是否与视频一致，而验证器本身也是依据一个分数来挑选的。我们证明，这一分数强烈依赖于测试中的两个设计选择——负例的类型和判断界面——其影响之大，足以颠覆关于模型能力以及应部署哪个验证器的结论。我们通过具有精确真值条件的受控构造将这两个因素分离：端点匹配负例（仅在内部状态上有误）以及真值切换测试（其中相同的两个候选答案在两个视频之间互换正确性）。在直接判断方式下，即从答案分数中读取判定结果时，那些能够拒绝明显错误开头的模型，在面对端点匹配负例时准确率降至接近随机水平。当视频帧揭示每个事件时，先写出推理过程再给出答案，可使四个模型中的三个在真值切换测试上的表现从低于10%提升到70-100%，而分阶段输入将直接判断的失败追溯到某一个步骤（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 视频验证器的评估得分严重依赖负例类型与判断界面这两个测试设计选择，甚至足以颠覆关于模型能力和验证器选型的结论；借助端点匹配负例与真值切换测试等精确真值条件构造，研究发现让模型先写出推理再作答可将多数模型表现从不足10%提升至70-100%。
en_tdlr: Video verifier evaluation scores depend strongly on the type of negative and the judgment interface—enough to reverse conclusions about model capability and verifier selection—and controlled tests with exact truth conditions show that writing out reasoning before answering lifts most models from under 10% to 70-100% accuracy.
